title: Mobile Developer (iOS)
text:
Pocket Health is growing its mobile team. We're looking for an iOS developer to help build our patient app.

We work in a hybrid setup: three days a week at our London office.

About you
- Solid experience building iOS apps with Swift and SwiftUI.
- You've shipped at least one app to the App Store.
- Comfortable with REST APIs and Combine or async/await.
- You care about automated testing (XCTest).
- Right to work in the UK.

Nice to have
- Kotlin / Android experience.
- Experience in a regulated industry (healthcare, finance).
